aegisAllowlist.src/stdlib/crypto.rs: explicit crypto.encrypt_aegis / crypto.decrypt_aegis entry points (#[allow(dead_code)]; feature-gated behind the non-default 'aegis' feature as of W2-11; reachable only via explicit crypto.* dispatch); the ONLY permitted AEGIS site outside crates/tallow-crypto/

aegisStance.enforcement: AEGIS use sites (both registered variants, per E-3-08) must stay inside crates/tallow-crypto/, with exactly one explicit annotated exception (E-2-01: AEGIS_OUTSIDE_ALLOWLIST — the stdlib entry points in src/stdlib/crypto.rs); aegisSitesOutsideTallowCrypto must be empty (it lists only unexcused sites) and aegisAllowedOutsideTallowCrypto records every conscious exception — a single-file allowance, never a blanket rule; the allowance is occurrence-ceilinged (aegisAllowanceCeiling vs aegisAllowanceOccurrences, W2-11) so a second AEGIS endpoint in the allowed file cannot land silently. The feature gate is asserted on BOTH sides: the crates/tallow-crypto manifest (optional dep behind 'aegis') and, since W2-11, the root manifest (aegis dependency optional behind the non-default 'aegis' feature; the stdlib entry points compile to honest 'not enabled' errors without it) — E-2-01 §1(c)/§3's dependency-gate recommendation, narrower option.
aegisStance.rule: AEGIS (AEGIS-128L / AEGIS-256) stays feature-gated and optional at most - never a default AEAD

novelAeadRule.detection: AEAD-shaped tokens captured by DISCOVERY that do not full-match a registered aead pattern (novelAeadCandidates must be empty)
novelAeadRule.rule: no novel AEADs: an AEAD/cipher-suite token outside the registered AEAD set must be consciously registered (with rationale) or removed before --check can pass

oneParamsSource.enforcement: --check fails on any crypto-shaped token not covered by a REGISTRY entry; the committed artifact is byte-gated, so registry/parameter changes land atomically with the artifact update (--write in the same change)
oneParamsSource.history: P10-F6 — Argon2id constants were duplicated x4 (crate vs vault plumbing); fix = one implementation + versioned params in the container header
oneParamsSource.paramsSource: scripts/crypto-inventory.py:REGISTRY (bound by registrySha256 in this artifact)
oneParamsSource.rule: REGISTRY (scripts/crypto-inventory.py) is the single source of truth for the primitive set; algorithm parameters at use sites must derive from / be cross-checked against the central tallow-crypto definitions, never a second algorithm/params table
